information_gain: Price only the 70 newly proved symbols. Market-neutral terminal-payoff floor, not a forecast; preserve every eligible and ineligible row. This is one metadata-qualified population, not repeated polling.
cost_interpretation: 33.5-bip stress is the unchanged rejection hurdle, not an actual account commission or a complete executable cost. No favorable funding, zero expiry basis or executable quantity is proved.
decision_rules: Source failure stops before further requests; any failed source, missing required ticker, expired contract or malformed value terminalizes without repair.
Call gross floor is perpetual bid minus strike minus option ask; put floor is strike minus perpetual ask minus option ask; unit must equal one.
Zero/missing entry prices are not free; all tested symbols remain in evidence or the run fails closed.
Survivors must conjoin strict positive gross less fixed stress with the 10000ms request-start-skew gate. Request receipts do not prove internal quote freshness.
No survivor means no depth, funding, fee, account, order or follow-up price request. A survivor needs separately frozen full costs, expiry basis, adverse funding, ticks and quantity before any depth.
Account qualification, recurring all-cost economics and all original promotion requirements remain mandatory; no accepted edge or trading authority follows.
